---
applyTo: "**/*.tsx,**/*.ts"
---

# Internationalization (i18n) Instructions

## Key Conventions

- [ ] All user-facing strings must use translations
- [ ] Use nested keys for organization (e.g., `form.errors.required`)
- [ ] Use interpolation for dynamic values (e.g., `{field}`)
- [ ] Schemas with i18n MUST use getter functions
- [ ] Import `useTranslation` from `@/i18n` (not from `react-i18next`)

## Translation Files Structure

```json
// i18n/locales/en.json
{
  "common": {
    "close": "Close",
    "save": "Save",
    "cancel": "Cancel"
  },
  "form": {
    "email": "Email",
    "password": "Password",
    "errors": {
      "invalidField": "{field} is invalid",
      "minLength": "{field} must be at least {length} characters",
      "required": "{field} is required"
    }
  },
  "users": {
    "created": "User created successfully",
    "updated": "User updated successfully",
    "deleted": "User deleted successfully"
  }
}
```

## ✅ DO

```typescript
import { useTranslation } from "@/i18n";

const Component = () => {
  const { t } = useTranslation();

  return <p>{t("common.close")}</p>;
};

// With interpolation
t("form.errors.minLength", { field: "Password", length: 8 });

// In schemas (getter function)
export const getLoginSchema = () => {
  return z.object({
    email: z.email({ message: i18n.t("form.errors.invalidField", { field: i18n.t("form.email") }) }),
  });
};
```

## ❌ DON'T

```typescript
// ❌ Don't import from react-i18next directly
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next"; // ❌ Use @/i18n wrapper

// ❌ Don't use hardcoded strings
const Component = () => {
  return <p>Close</p>; // ❌ Hardcoded string
};

// ❌ Don't concatenate translations
t("form.errors.required") + " " + t("form.email"); // ❌ Use interpolation instead

// ❌ Don't forget to add keys to translation files
t("some.key.that.doesnt.exist"); // ❌ Will show the key as fallback

// ❌ Don't use i18n in constant schemas
export const loginSchema = z.object({
  email: z.email({ message: i18n.t("form.errors.invalidField") }), // ❌ i18n not ready at module load
});
```
